notes: «قال إسحاق وعبد أخبرنا وقال الآخران، حدثنا» differs only in the verb: all four share the level عبد الرزاق, so it is one group.
«وألفاظهم، متقاربة» is a remark on wording: left out. The dash-set «- أخبرنا معمر -» is a transmission verb before a name: معمر is kept.
The last link is ابن عمر, whose account of Hafsa's words and the Prophet's ruling is the saying.
